blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The task of 3D assembly requires translating an understanding of parts and their relationships into precise spatial arrangements. Can pretrained general-purpose agents assemble objects through visual interaction without additional assembly-specific fine-tuning? To investigate this question, we introduce AssemblyWorld , an interactive 3D environment in which agents inspect rendered views and manipulate supplied rigid parts, guided by images or assembly manuals when available. Agents perceive part geometry through 2D views rather than direct access to mesh vertices or faces, while their resulting assemblies are evaluated geometrically. Building on this environment, we construct AssemblyWorldBench , comprising 100 assembly tasks across 80 objects spanning furniture, industrial assembly, and fracture reassembly. Evaluating eight agent systems reveals substantial differences in their capabilities. The strongest system achieves 80.9% part accuracy but 59.4% complete-assembly success. The evaluated open-source systems lag substantially behind their stronger closed-source peers in both execution reliability and assembly accuracy. Analyses of visual references, interaction trajectories, and failures show how agents revise assemblies while leaving residual positioning errors. AssemblyWorld provides a common setting for both assessing the capabilities of interactive assembly agents and characterizing the gap between approximate structure recovery and precise reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 3D组装的任务需要将对部件及其关系的理解转化为精确的空间安排. 预先训练的通用剂能否通过视觉相互作用来组装物体,而无需额外的组装特定微调? 为了调查这个问题,我们介绍了AssemblyWorld,这是一种互动的三维环境,在这种环境中,特工人员在有图像或装配手册的情况下,检查观点并操纵所提供的硬性部件。 代理人通过2D视图来感知部分几何,而不是直接接触网顶或面部,而其产生的集合则通过几何评价. 在这个环境的基础上,我们建造了Assembly World Bench, 包括100个组装任务, 涉及80个物体, 包括家具、工业组装和断裂组装。 评估八个代理系统发现它们的能力有很大差异。 最强系统实现80.9%的部分精度,但59.4%的全组装成功. 所评估的开源系统在执行可靠性和组装准确性方面都大大落后于其较强的开源系统。 对视觉参考、相互作用轨迹和故障的分析表明,物剂如何在留下剩余定位错误的同时修正组件。 AssemblyWorld为评估交互式组装代理商的能力和描述大约结构恢复与准确重建之间的差距提供了一个共同的环境。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Assembling an object requires more than recognizing its parts or understanding what the finished object should look like. A chair may have all its legs beneath the seat and still be incorrectly assembled: connections must align, parts must be correctly oriented, and even small positional errors can leave the object assembly incomplete. These demands arise across domains: furniture assembly ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) , industrial components ( Li et al., 2026 ) , and fracture reconstruction ( Li et al., 2025 ) , although the available clues range from well-illustrated manuals to just the geometry of the parts alone.
The task of 3D assembly therefore provides a concrete test of whether an intelligent system can translate visual and spatial reasoning into precise transformations in a 3D world.
blocks.zh:
集合一个对象需要的不仅仅是识别其部分或者理解完成对象应该是什么样子. 椅子在座椅下方可能有其所有腿部,仍然不正确组装:连接必须对齐,零件必须正确定向,即使是小位置错误也可能使对象组装不完整. 这些需求涉及多个领域:家具组装(Zhang等人,2025a),工业部件。 (Li et al., 2026),和断裂重建(Li et al., 2025),虽然现有的线索从精密的手册到仅仅是部分的几何.
因此,3D组装的任务为智能系统能否将视觉和空间推理转化为3D世界的精确转化提供了具体的测试.

blocks.en:
A substantial body of work studies geometric representations ( Huang et al., 2020 ; Harish et al., 2022 ; Du et al., 2024 ) and learned pose prediction ( Zhang et al., 2022 ; Cheng et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) for 3D part assembly. Reference-guided methods further use assembled-object images or instruction diagrams to inform part placement ( Li et al., 2020 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) .
For example, Zhang et al. (2025a) exploit instruction diagrams in Manual-PA, while Li et al. (2025) model geometric relationships between fragments in GARF.
General-purpose agents built on models from the OpenAI GPT and Qwen families ( OpenAI, 2023 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) offer a complementary approach. Through tool calls, models specify operations for an execution harness to perform and receive their outputs as context for subsequent decisions. In a 3D environment, this allows an agent to inspect a scene, manipulate parts, and use further observations to revise its decisions. This setting requires choosing informative viewpoints, relating observations across views, and translating an assembly hypothesis into numerical pose edits. Because edits change subsequent observations, the agent must also detect and correct its own errors throughout interaction. Success must therefore be assessed from the assembled geometry, since a plausible verbal explanation need not imply accurate part placement. This raises a central question: can pretrained general-purpose agents assemble objects through visual interaction without additional assembly-specific fine-tuning? Answering it requires an environment that connects observations to executable geometric actions and supports comparisons across assembly domains, reference conditions, and agent systems.
blocks.zh:
大量工作研究的几何表达法(黄.等人,2020年;Harish等人,2022年;Du等人,2024年)和学会的预测(张 al等人,2022年;程.等人,2023年;徐 al等人,2025年;赵 al等人,2025年;张 al等人,2025年b)用于3D部分组装. 参考指导方法进一步使用组装对象图像或指示图,为部分放置提供信息(Li等人,2020年;Wang等人,2025年a); 张等,2025a).
举例来说, Zhang等人(2025a)在《手册-PA》中利用指导图,而Li等人则利用指导图。 (2025)GARF中碎片之间的模型几何关系.
通用剂基于OpenAI GPT和Quen家族的模型(OpenAI, 2023年;Yang等人, 2025年)提供了一种补充方法。 通过工具调用,模型指定执行工具的操作,以完成和接收其产出,作为随后决定的背景。 在3D环境中,这允许代理人检查一个场景,操纵零件,并利用进一步的观察来修改其决定. 这种设置需要选择信息化的观点,将各种观点的观察联系起来,并将集合假说转换成数字形式编辑。 由于编辑会改变后续的观测结果,代理商还必须在整个互动过程中发现并纠正自己的错误. 因此,必须根据集合的几何学来评估成功与否,因为合理的口头解释不一定意味着准确的部分位置。 这提出了一个中心问题:预先训练的通用剂能否通过视觉交互来组装物体,而无需额外的组装特定微调? 回答它需要一个环境,将观测与可执行的几何动作联系起来,并支持在组装域、参考条件和代理系统之间进行比较。

blocks.en: Towards this end, we introduce AssemblyWorld , an interactive 3D environment for assembling supplied rigid object parts. Within this environment, agents inspect rendered 2D views, choose camera viewpoints, and translate or rotate individual object parts and groups. When available, images of the completed object or assembly manuals provide visual guidance. Since object parts are rigid, agents must solve the task by arranging the given object components. As illustrated in Figure 1 , the same observation-action interface supports furniture, industrial assembly, and fracture reassembly. Geometric evaluation measures accuracy of the resulting configurations, while recorded states make it possible to examine how an assembly develops throughout interaction.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们引入了AssemblyWorld,用于组合所提供的刚性物体部件的交互式三维环境。 在此环境中,代理检查提供了2D视图,选择了相机视角,并翻译或旋转单个对象部件和组. 完成的物体或组装手册的图像在可用时提供视觉指导。 由于对象部分是刚性的,代理必须安排给定对象部分来解决任务. 如图1所示,同一观测-行动接口支持家具、工业组装和断裂重新组装。 几何评价测量了所形成的配置的准确性,同时记录的状态使得可以检查一个组装在整个互动过程中是如何发展的.

blocks.en: Building on this environment, we construct AssemblyWorldBench , a benchmark comprising 80 objects selected from PartNet ( Mo et al., 2019 ) , IKEA-Manual ( Wang et al., 2022 ) , AssemblyBench ( Li et al., 2026 ) , and Fantastic Breaks ( Lamb et al., 2023 ) . Each assembly task consists of an object’s parts in a fixed initial configuration and the reference information provided to the agent. We evaluate each of the 20 PartNet objects both with and without an assembled-object image, and each of the remaining 60 objects under its dataset-specific reference setting, yielding 100 assembly tasks across 80 distinct objects. Standardized initial configurations and a common execution budget enable comparisons across eight agent systems. Larger source-level evaluations complement this benchmark by placing agent performance alongside specialized assembly methods. These settings connect cross-domain evaluation with analyses of reference use, interaction dynamics, and residual errors.
blocks.zh: 基于这一环境,我们构建了AssemblyWorld Bench, 由从PartNet(Mo等人, 2019年), IKEA-Manual(Wang等人, 2022年), Assembly Bench 选出的80个对象构成的基准. (Li等人,2026年),和奇异断裂(Lamb等人,2023年). 每个组装任务由一个固定初始配置中的对象部件和提供给代理人的参考信息组成. 我们评价20个PartNet物体中的每一个,无论有无组装对象图像,其余60个物体中每一个都在其数据集特定参考设定下,在80个不同物体中产生100个组装任务。 标准化的初始配置和共同执行预算使8个代理系统能够进行比较。 较大来源一级的评价通过将代理业绩与专门组装方法相结合来补充这一基准。 这些设置将跨域评价与参考使用、互动动态和剩余错误分析联系起来。

blocks.en:
Our results show strong assembly capability but a gap between partial progress and complete reconstruction.
The strongest system achieves 80.9% part accuracy but only 59.4% complete-assembly success on the common benchmark, while the evaluated open-source systems lag substantially behind their stronger closed-source peers in execution reliability and assembly accuracy. Visual references improve performance for the stronger systems, while trajectories reveal how agents alternate inspection and manipulation, revise intermediate arrangements, and sometimes terminate with unresolved positional errors. Additional experiments examine sensitivity to task variations and the potential for combining interactive agents with specialized geometric models. Together, these findings identify the precision and reliability challenges that remain for general-purpose assembly agents.
blocks.zh:
我们的结果表明,装配能力很强,但部分进展与完全重建之间存在差距。
最强的系统实现了80.9%的部分精度,但在共同基准上只有59.4%的完整组装成功,而被评价的开源系统在执行可靠性和组装精度方面大大落后于其更强的闭源同行. 视觉参考可以改善较强系统的性能,而轨迹则揭示代理人如何交替检查和操纵,修改中间安排,有时会随着未解决的位置错误而终止. 其他实验研究了任务变化的敏感性以及将交互式剂与专用几何模型相结合的可能性。 这些结论共同确定了普通用途装配剂在准确性和可靠性方面仍然存在的挑战。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Learning-Based and Instruction-Guided Assembly. Learning-based 3D assembly models relative part poses using geometric and structural cues, including graph- and hierarchy-based reasoning ( Huang et al., 2020 ; Du et al., 2024 ) , generative pose modeling ( Cheng et al., 2023 ) , and visual or instructional guidance ( Li et al., 2020 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) . Recent language-based methods further incorporate geometric encoding, manual understanding, and constraint reasoning ( Jing et al., 2026 ; Tie et al., 2025 ; Tie et al., 2026 ) . Fracture reassembly instead relies more heavily on geometric correspondence between fragments ( Lu et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025b ) .
In contrast, we study whether general-purpose agents can perform these assembly tasks through rendered observations and pose-editing tools without additional assembly-specific fine-tuning.
blocks.zh:
学习和指导大会。 基于学习的3D组装模型相对部分使用几何和结构提示,包括基于图表和层次的推理(黄等人,2020年;杜等人,2024年),基因造型模型(程等人,2023年),以及视觉或指导指导(李等人,2020年;张等人,2025年a). 最近的基于语言的方法进一步包含了几何编码,人工理解,以及约束推理(Jing等人,2026年;Tie等人,2025年;Tie等人,2026年). 相反,裂痕重新组装更依赖于碎片之间的几何对应(Lu等人,2023年;Li等人,2025年;Sun等人,2025年b)。
与此相对照,我们研究通用剂是否能够通过提供的观测和摆设编辑工具来完成这些组装任务,而不进行额外的组装特定微调。

blocks.en:
3D Assembly Datasets and Benchmarks. Existing datasets capture complementary aspects of the task of 3D assembly.
PartNet provides hierarchically annotated object parts ( Mo et al., 2019 ) , IKEA-Manual pairs furniture geometry with real assembly instructions ( Wang et al., 2022 ) , and AssemblyBench extends instruction-guided assembly to industrial objects ( Li et al., 2026 ) . For fracture reconstruction, Breaking Bad provides simulated fractures ( Sellán et al., 2022 ) , while Fantastic Breaks provides scans of physically broken objects ( Lamb et al., 2023 ) .
AssemblyWorldBench unifies subsets of these datasets in a common interactive environment with standardized initialization and geometric evaluation, enabling cross-domain agent comparison while retaining the reference conditions used by each dataset.
blocks.zh:
三维大会数据集与基准. 现有的数据集捕捉到三维组装任务的互补方面.
PartNet提供分级附加注释的物体部件(Mo等人,2019年),IKEA-Manual配对家具几何,并附有真实的组装指令(Wang等人,2022年),Assembly Bench将指令引导组装扩展至工业物体(Li等人,2026年). 对于骨折重建,Breaking Bad提供模拟骨折(Sellán等人,2022年),而Freast Breaks则提供物理断裂物体的扫描(Lamb等人,2023年).
AssemblyWorld Bench在具有标准化初始化和几何评价的共同互动环境中统一了这些数据集的子集,可以进行跨域代理比较,同时保留每个数据集使用的参考条件.

blocks.en: Interactive Agents in 3D Environments. Tool-using agents connect language and visual reasoning to actions in executable environments. Liang et al. (2023) generate action programs in Code as Policies, while Huang et al. (2023) and Huang et al. (2025) use spatial objectives and constraints in VoxPoser and ReKep. Related work in 3D content creation includes procedural modeling in 3D-GPT ( Sun et al., 2025a ) and iterative scene reconstruction through rendered feedback in Thinking in Blender ( He et al., 2026 ) and VIGA ( Yin et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, AssemblyWorld studies interactive assembly of a fixed set of parts through rendered observations and pose-editing tools, with execution-based evaluation following the paradigm of OSWorld ( Xie et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 3D环境的交互式代理. 工具使用代理将语言和视觉推理与可执行环境中的行动联系起来. 梁等人(2023年)在法典中生成行动方案作为政策,而黄等人(2023年)和黄等人(2025年)在VoxPoser和ReKep中使用空间目标和约束. 3D内容创建的相关工作包括3D-GPT(Sun等人,2025年a)的程序建模,以及通过在Blender(He等人,2026年)和VIGA(Yin等人,2026年)的思考中提供反馈进行迭代场景重建. 相反,AssemblyWorld通过提供观察和造型编辑工具,对一组固定部件进行交互式组装,并采用OSWorld的模式进行基于执行的评价(Xie等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: 3 AssemblyWorld
blocks.zh: 3 大会世界

blocks.en: 3.1 Task Formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1 制定任务

blocks.en: We study the task of interactive 3D assembly of a fixed set of rigid parts. The task setup provides part meshes ℳ = { M i } i = 1 n \mathcal{M}=\{M_{i}\}_{i=1}^{n} in a separated initial configuration, together with optional reference information r r , such as an image of the completed object or an assembly manual. The agent accesses the parts through a 3D environment and uses observations and manipulation actions to determine their final poses T ^ i ∈ SE ⁡ ( 3 ) \widehat{T}_{i}\in\mathrm{SE}(3) . Part geometry and relative scale remain fixed throughout interaction. The objective is to assemble the supplied parts into a coherent object, following the reference image or instructions when provided.
blocks.zh: 我们研究一套固定的刚性部件的交互式三维组装。 任务设置提供部分 meshes M = {M i } i = 1 n\ mathcal{M}=\{M_{i}\}_{i=i=1}^{n}在独立的初始配置中,同时提供可选的参考信息r r ,例如完成对象的图像或组装手册. 代理通过3D环境访问这些部件,并使用观察和操纵动作来决定其最终构成 T ^ i → SE → (3)\groundhat{T}_{i}\in\ mathrm{SE}(3). 部分几何学和相对尺度在整个相互作用过程中保持不变。 目的是按照提供的参考图像或指示,将所提供的部件组合成一个连贯的对象。

blocks.en: 3.2 Interactive 3D Environment
blocks.zh: 3.2 交互式三维环境

blocks.en: General-purpose agents interact with external environments through predefined tools. The model selects a tool and generates its arguments; the execution harness invokes the operation and returns its output to the model. In AssemblyWorld (Figure 1 ), these tools are exposed through Model Context Protocol (MCP): an agent can request a rendered view, choose a part translation or rotation, and then request another view to inspect the change. The returned information becomes part of the context for subsequent decisions.
blocks.zh: 通用剂通过预先定义的工具与外部环境相互作用. 模型会选择一个工具并生成其参数;执行工具会引用操作并返回其输出到模型中. 在AssemblyWorld(图1)中,这些工具通过模型上下文协议(MCP)被曝光:一个代理可以请求一个渲染的视图,选择一个部分翻译或旋转,然后请求另一个视图来检查修改. 退回的信息成为随后决定的背景的一部分。

blocks.en: Observation. The agent observes the current assembly through rendered 2D views and can adjust the camera to inspect connections from different viewpoints. Scene-query tools supplement these observations with structured records: list_objects returns part identifiers, while get_object reports a selected part’s body position, orientation, and mesh-local bounding dimensions. Mesh vertices and faces are hidden; part geometry must be inferred from rendered views.
blocks.zh: 观察. 代理通过渲染的2D视图观察当前组装,并可调整相机以从不同角度检查连接. Scene-query工具用结构化记录来补充这些观测:list_objects返回部分标识符,同时 get_object报告一个选定部分的身体位置,方向,以及网-局部的绑定维度. 网状顶点和面孔是隐藏的;部分几何必须从提供的观点中推断出来.

blocks.en: Manipulation and Interaction. Tool descriptions specify the available operations and their arguments. To translate or rotate parts, the agent selects their identifiers and specifies a translation vector or rotation angles. It can also choose the coordinate frame and, for rotations, a pivot. Group operations allow several parts to be repositioned together while preserving their relative configuration. The environment executes the requested transformation and returns its status; the agent can then request a rendered view to inspect the result.
blocks.zh: 操纵与互动. 工具描述指定可用的操作及其参数. 要翻译或旋转部件,代理人会选择其标识符,并指定一个翻译矢量或旋转角度. 它还可以选择坐标框架,而对于旋转,则可以选择一个枢轴. 分组操作在保留其相对配置的同时,允许多个部分重新组合在一起. 环境执行所请求的转换并返回其状态;然后,代理人可以请求一个已渲染的视图来检查结果。

blocks.en: The agent determines the sequence of observations and edits and when to finish. We record the operations and resulting states, retaining the final configuration when execution ends.
blocks.zh: 代理确定观察和编辑的顺序以及何时完成. 我们记录操作和结果状态,在执行结束时保留最终配置.

blocks.en: 3.3 Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 3.3 基准建设

blocks.en: 3D Assembly Datasets. AssemblyWorldBench covers three assembly domains using four datasets. PartNet ( Mo et al., 2019 ) and IKEA-Manual ( Wang et al., 2022 ) provide furniture with semantic parts, such as seats, legs, and tabletops, whose functional roles and spatial relationships help determine the object structure. AssemblyBench ( Li et al., 2026 ) provides complex industrial assemblies, where components must be arranged according to their geometric fit and mating relationships. Fantastic Breaks ( Lamb et al., 2023 ) contains fractured objects whose fragments provide complementary surface geometry, rather than the semantic part structure (as in furniture assembly).
blocks.zh: 3D大会数据集. 世界大会 座椅使用四个数据集覆盖三个集合域. PartNet(Mo等人,2019年)和IKEA-Manual(Wang等人,2022年)提供带有语义部件的家具,如座椅,腿,以及台顶,其功能作用和空间关系有助于决定物体结构. Assembly Bench(Li et al.,2026)提供复杂的工业组件,其组件必须根据其几何适应和交配的关系排列. 奇异断裂(Lamb等人,2023年)包含断裂物体,其碎片提供了互补的表面几何,而不是语义部分结构(如家具组装).

blocks.en: Reference Conditions. IKEA-Manual provides real-world IKEA assembly instructions, whereas AssemblyBench provides sequences of rendered assembly diagrams shown from a consistent viewpoint. Fantastic Breaks tasks provide no reference. For PartNet, we evaluate each object both without a reference and with an image of the fully assembled furniture, using the same geometry and initial configuration in both conditions. The paired conditions allow us to compare performance with and without a reference image on the same objects. With only a fixed reference image, the agent must infer occluded part placements from the supplied parts and visible structure. We evaluate the final assembly geometry rather than agreement with an illustrated operation sequence.
blocks.zh: 参考条件. IKEA-Manual提供真实世界的IKEA组装指令,而Assembench提供从一致角度显示的成型组装图的序列. 厉害 中断任务不提供参考 。 对于PartNet,我们用完全组装的家具的图像来评价每个物体,在两种条件下使用相同的几何和初始配置. 配对条件使我们能够比较性能与和没有在相同物体上的参考图像. 只有固定的参考图像,代理人必须推断从所提供的部件和可见结构中渗出部分位置。 我们评价最后的组装几何,而不是同意一个说明的操作序列。

blocks.en: Standardized Initial Configurations. We apply the same initialization procedure across datasets. All parts of an object use a shared scale to preserve their relative dimensions. Each part is placed in a local coordinate frame defined by its principal axes, assigned a randomized yaw, and scattered into a separated initial layout. The normalization scale depends only on individual part geometry. We fix the initial configuration of each object across all evaluated systems.
blocks.zh: 标准化初始配置. 我们对数据集采用相同的初始化程序。 物体的所有部分都使用共享尺度来保存其相对尺寸. 每个部分被放置在其主轴定义的局部坐标框中,分配一个随机的yaw,并分散成一个独立的初始布局. 正常化尺度只取决于个别部分几何。 我们在所有被评价的系统中确定每个物体的初步配置。

blocks.en: Benchmark Composition. We select 20 objects from each dataset through random sampling with part-count stratification where part counts vary. The resulting benchmark provides a common set of assembly tasks for comparing general-purpose agents across domains and reference conditions. The Fantastic Breaks subset contains only two-part objects. Evaluating each PartNet object both with and without a reference image yields 100 assembly tasks across 80 distinct objects. Appendix A provides task construction and execution details.
blocks.zh: 基准构成。 我们通过随机抽样从每个数据集中选择20个物体,其中部分计数的分层结构各不相同。 由此产生的基准提供了一套共同的组装任务,用于在不同领域和参考条件之间比较通用剂。 "神奇断层"子集只包含两个部分的对象. 评估每个有参考图像或没有参考图像的PartNet对象,可产生80个不同对象的100项组装任务。 附 录 A提供任务构建和执行的细节.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Evaluation Settings. We compare eight agents on the 100 assembly tasks of AssemblyWorldBench, constructed from the four datasets described in Section 3.3 . We also evaluate GPT-6 Astra on larger subsets of these datasets for comparison with specialized methods.
blocks.zh: 评价设置. 我们比较了AssemblyWorld Bench的100项组装任务中的8个代理人,这些任务是根据第3.3节所述四个数据集构建的。 我们还对这些数据集较大的子集进行GPT-6 Astra评价,以便与专门方法进行比较。

blocks.en: Agents and Execution Protocol. Table 1 lists the eight agents and their resource use. GPT, Qwen, and DeepSeek use Codex, with provider adapters for the latter two; Claude models use Claude Code. All systems share the environment tools, initial configurations, task instructions, and 60-minute execution limit. We score the final exported configuration, including partial assemblies after errors or timeouts.
blocks.zh: 特工和执行协议 表1列出了8种制剂及其资源使用情况。 GPT,Quen,和DeepSeek使用Codex,后两者的供应商适配器;克劳德模型使用Claude Code. 所有系统都共享环境工具,初始配置,任务指令,以及60分钟的执行限制. 我们得分最终导出配置,包括错误或超时后的部分组件.

blocks.en:
Evaluation Metrics. For the common benchmark, predicted assemblies are globally aligned to the targets before evaluation, and geometrically equivalent parts are matched using Hungarian assignment.
We report shape Chamfer distance (SCD), part accuracy (PA), and shape success rate (SR). SCD measures the squared bidirectional Chamfer distance between the complete predicted and target assemblies. PA is the fraction of correctly placed parts, where a part is considered correct if its squared bidirectional Chamfer distance to the matched target part is at most 0.01 0.01 . SR requires all parts of an object to be correct.
In our free-space setting, unfinished assemblies may leave parts far from their targets, so a small number of severe failures can dominate the mean SCD.
PA and SR are reported as percentages and SCD as × 1000 \times 1000 . Overall PA and SR average the four datasets equally, with the two PartNet reference conditions averaged first. The source-level Fantastic Breaks comparison uses a separate anchor-aligned protocol.
Appendices A – B provide evaluation details and supplementary quantitative results.
blocks.zh:
评价计量。 就共同基准而言,预测的组件在全球与评价前的目标一致,并使用匈牙利的任务对等几何部分进行配对。
我们报告Chamfer距离(SCD)、部分精确度(PA)和成形成功率(SR)。 SCD测量完全预测与目标组装之间的平方双向Chamfer距离. PA是正确放置部分的一小部分,如果一个部分与匹配的目标部分的平方双向Chamfer距离最多为0.01 0.01,则该部分被认为是正确的。 SR要求对象的所有部分正确.
在我们的自由空间环境中,未完成的集合可能会留下远离目标的部分,因此少数严重的失败可以支配平均SCD.
PA和SR报告为百分比,SCD报告为×1000\时。 总体而言,巴勒斯坦权力机构和斯洛伐克共和国平均平均为四个数据集,两个部分网的参考条件平均为第一。 源级的"神奇断层"比较使用单独的锚对接协议.
附录A-B提供评价细节和补充量化结果。

blocks.en: 4.2 Results on AssemblyWorldBench
blocks.zh: 4.2 关于大会世界奔驰的成果

blocks.en: Table 1: AssemblyWorldBench results: SR (%) and mean resource use for eight agents. NR, IR, and M denote no reference, an assembled-object image, and a manual. IKEA, AB, and FB denote IKEA-Manual, AssemblyBench, and Fantastic Breaks. Bold marks the highest SR or lowest resource use. † † nicematrix-placeholder: NiceTabular* (nicematrix)

Table 1 compares assembly quality and resource use across the eight systems. Astra achieves the highest overall SR at 59.4%, followed by Fable at 50.0% and Opus at 44.4%. Performance nevertheless varies across domains: Astra and Fable both reach 90% SR on two-part fracture reassembly, but only 40% and 25%, respectively, on image-conditioned PartNet tasks. High success on fragment alignment therefore does not extend uniformly to multi-part furniture assembly.
blocks.zh: 表1比较了8个系统的组装质量和资源使用情况。 Astra的总成绩最高,为59.4%,其次是Fable为50.0%,Opus为44.4%。 Astra 和 Fable 在两段断裂重新组装时都达到了90%的SR, 但分别只有40% 和 25% 在图像配置的 PartNet 任务上。 因此,在片段对齐方面取得的很大成功并不统一适用于多部分家具组装。

blocks.en: Qwen reaches 35% SR on two-part fracture reassembly, but its overall SR is 11.9%; DeepSeek completes no task successfully. Of their 100 evaluations, 65 and 17 reach the time limit, while another 14 and 34 end in execution failures. These results reflect the deployed model–harness combinations, including execution reliability as well as assembly accuracy.
blocks.zh: Quen在两段断裂重组时达到35%的SR,但其总体SR为11.9%; DeepSeek没有成功完成任何任务. 在100项评价中,65项和17项达到时限,另外14项和34项则以执行失败告终。 这些结果反映了所部署的模型-缺陷组合,包括执行的可靠性和组装的准确性。

blocks.en: Time and Computational Cost. Higher success does not necessarily require more time or tool calls. Astra averages 5.8 minutes and 94 calls per evaluation, versus Sol’s 8.7 minutes and 208 calls, while achieving substantially higher SR. Astra also uses less time and recorded cost than Fable and Opus, whereas Terra uses fewer resources but reaches only 7.5% SR.
blocks.zh: 时间和计算成本。 更高的成功并不一定需要更多的时间或工具调用. Astra平均每次评价平均5.8分钟和94次通话,而Sol的8.7分钟和208次通话,同时实现高得多的SR. Astra使用的时间和记录成本也少于Fable和Opus,而Terra使用的资源较少,但只达到7.5%的SR.

blocks.en: 4.3 Comparison with Specialized Assembly Methods
blocks.zh: 4.3 与专门大会方法的比较

blocks.en: Tables 2 – 5 compare Astra with specialized assembly methods on larger source-level evaluation sets, using the reported settings of each method.
blocks.zh: 表2 - 5 比较 利用每种方法上报的设置,在较大源一级评价组上采用专门组装方法。

blocks.en: Table 2: Assembly results on PartNet. Astra uses no target reference (–) or an image of the assembled furniture; scene observation is available in both conditions. † † nicematrix-placeholder: NiceTabular* (nicematrix)

Furniture Assembly. PartNet methods commonly train category-specific models, including Manual-PA, Imagine ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , and Assembler ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) . Cross-category transfer is studied by Manual-PA and Imagine, and multi-category training by SPAFormer ( Xu et al., 2025 ) and Assembler. We use the same pretrained Astra agent across furniture categories without additional assembly-specific fine-tuning or category-specific models.
blocks.zh: 家具大会。 PartNet的方法一般是训练特定类别模型,包括Mannual-PA,Imagine(Wang等人,2025a)和Assembler(赵等人,2025年)。 跨类别转让由Mandrale-PA和Imagine研究,多类别培训由SPAFormer(徐等人,2025年)和Assembler研究. 我们使用相同的预先训练过的Astra剂,跨越家具类别,没有额外的组装特定微调或类别特定模型.

blocks.en: With image guidance, Astra exceeds the compared methods in PA and SR across all three PartNet categories (Table 2 ), reaching 85.35% PA and 63.60% SR on tables. Removing the reference reduces PA in every category. Image-conditioned Storage reaches 63.87% PA but only 20.27% SR, illustrating the gap between correctly placing individual parts and completing an assembly. Free-space failures can nevertheless dominate SCD: 8 of 148 image-conditioned Storage objects (5.4%) contribute 99.3% of summed SCD, with six retaining all initial part poses. Their separated parts yield large squared distances, unlike predictors with bounded translations such as DGL ( Huang et al., 2020 ) .
blocks.zh: 在图像指导下,Astra超越了PA和SR在所有三个部分网类别的比较方法(表2),在表格上达到85.35%的PA和63.60%的SR。 删除引用将减少每一类别的巴勒斯坦权力机构。 图像条件存储达到63.87%的PA,但只有20.27%的SR,说明正确放置单个部件和完成组装之间的差距. 尽管如此,空闲空间故障仍可主导SCD:148个图像条件存储对象中有8个(5.4%)占总和SCD的99.3%,其中6个保留了所有初始部分。 它们的分离部分产生很大的平方距离,不同于带有定界翻译的预测器,如DGL(Huang等人,2020年).

blocks.en: Table 3: Assembly results on IKEA-Manual. Subset columns use equal-category averages. PA and SR are percentages; SR requires all parts correct, whereas SR a \mathrm{SR}^{a} uses SCD < 0.02 <0.02 before scaling. † \dagger denotes Image-PA retrained on diagrams. † † nicematrix-placeholder: NiceTabular* (nicematrix)

Figure 2: Interaction dynamics of Astra and Fable across 100 evaluations each. (a–b) Mean call shares within active evaluation-bins. (c) Median per-evaluation translation and rotation magnitudes; translation is normalized by the largest-part diagonal. (d) Mean PA and SR. All four plots use benchmark source weights and normalized interaction time. In (c–d), colors identify systems; solid and dashed lines use the left and right axes, respectively.
blocks.zh: 图2:Astra和Fable在每次100项评价中的相互作用动态。 (a)-b) 活跃评价中的平均呼叫份额。 (c) 每个评价的中位数翻译和旋转幅度;翻译由最大部分对角法规范化。 (d) 巴勒斯坦权力机构和斯洛伐克共和国平均数。 所有四个地块都使用基准源加权数和正常交互时间. 在(c-d)中,颜色识别系统;固态线和虚态线分别使用左轴和右轴.

blocks.en: Real manuals add challenges beyond rendered diagrams: Manual-PA uses synthetic stepwise diagrams for PartNet and IKEA-Manual and identifies arrows, close-ups, part labels, and hierarchical subassemblies as obstacles to transfer. Manual2Skill handles real manuals with graph extraction and learned pose estimation. Astra instead uses the original IKEA pages to assemble through interaction, without additional assembly-specific fine-tuning or a dedicated pose predictor.
blocks.zh: 真实的手册除了制成的图外,还增加了挑战: Manual-PA为PartNet和IKEA-Manual使用合成的阶梯图,并将箭头,特写,部分标签,和分级子组装确定为传输障碍. 手动2Skill处理真实的手册,并带有图解提取和学到的布局估计. Astra转而使用IKEA的原始页面通过交互进行组装,没有额外的组装特定微调或专用的姿势预测器.

blocks.en: On IKEA-Manual (Table 3 ), Astra achieves category-averaged PA/SR of 93.27%/75.44% on Chair/Table, exceeding the compared methods. It also obtains lower SCD and higher SR a \mathrm{SR}^{a} on Full and Bench/Chair/Desk, with full-dataset SCD of 0.9 and 100% SR a \mathrm{SR}^{a} in both settings. These results show that a pretrained general-purpose agent can interpret real instruction manuals and construct furniture geometry through interaction, without an assembly-specific pose predictor.
blocks.zh: 在IKEA-手册(表3)上,Astra在主席/表格上的平均PA/SR为93.27%/75.44%,超过了比较方法。 它还在全程和座椅/主席/德士克上获得较低的SCD和更高的SR a\mathrm{SR}^{a},在两种设置中完整的数据集SCD为0.9和100%SR a\mathrm{SR}^{a}. 这些结果显示,经过预先训练的通用剂可以解释真实的教学手册,通过交互构造家具几何,而无需特定组装的姿势预测器.

blocks.en: Table 4: Assembly results on AssemblyBench. N N counts evaluated objects; PA/SR are percentages and SCD is scaled by 1000. Astra is evaluated on 279 of 280 objects, excluding one refusal involving a dangerous item.
blocks.zh: 表4:大会对Assembench的结果。 N 计数评价对象;PA/SR为百分比,SCD比例为1000。 对280件物品中的279件进行了评估,不包括一件涉及危险物品的拒绝。

blocks.en: Industrial Assembly. Industrial assembly introduces substantial differences in relative part size within a single object. The median largest-to-smallest part-size ratio is 4.39 on AssemblyBench, compared with 2.20 on IKEA-Manual and 1.79 on PartNet. The ratio of per-part PCA (principal component analysis) bounding-box diagonals is scale-invariant. Using stepwise rendered instructions, the same pretrained Astra agent achieves 78.32% PA and 55.91% SR across 279 AssemblyBench objects without additional assembly-specific fine-tuning, exceeding the reported results of the specialized methods in Table 4 .
blocks.zh: 工业大会. 工业组装在单个物体内造成相对部分尺寸的巨大差异。 Assembench的中位数最大和最小部分尺寸比率为4.39,而IKEA-Manual的中位数为2.20,PartNet的中位数为1.79。 每部分的五氯苯甲醚(主要成分分析)边框对角的比值是比例-不定的. 使用渐进指示,在279个装配式Bench物体上,经过预先训练的Astra剂达到78.32%的PA和55.91%的SR,但没有进行额外的装配专用微调,超过了表4中报告的专门方法的结果。

blocks.en: Table 5: Assembly results on Fantastic Breaks. RE/TE are rotation/translation errors. Units: RE in degrees, PA in percent, TE/CD scaled by 100/1000. RE is Euler-angle root mean square error (RMSE) for Jigsaw, PF++, GARF, and Astra; geodesic otherwise. Astra uses anchor alignment on 150 objects.
blocks.zh: 表5: 议会对“惊人的突破”的结果。 RE/TE是旋转/翻译错误. 单位:RE(学位)、PA(百分比)、TE/CD(100/1000) RE是Jigsaw、PF++、GARF和Astra的Euler-angle root平均方形错误(RMSE);否则就是大地测量。 Astra在150个物体上使用锚对齐.

blocks.en: Fracture Reassembly. In our fracture reassembly setting, agents receive no visual reference of the target object, such as an image of its intact shape. Within AssemblyWorld’s interactive 3D environment, the agent cannot directly access mesh vertices, faces, or point clouds; it must infer how fragments fit together and adjust their poses using feedback from rendered 2D views. Despite this observation constraint, Astra achieves 91.67% PA on 150 Fantastic Breaks objects without additional fracture-specific fine-tuning. Table 5 compares its performance with specialized methods using published results reported by Li et al. (2025) for GARF and Jia et al. (2026) for SARe. The higher PA and lower translation errors reported by recent specialized methods highlight their strength in precise fragment placement.
blocks.zh: 断裂复组. 在我们的断裂重新组装中,物剂没有收到目标物体的视觉参考,例如其完好无缺的形状的图像. 在AssemblyWorld的交互式三维环境中,代理无法直接访问网点、面孔或点云;它必须推断碎片是如何组合在一起的,并使用所给出的二维视图的反馈来调整它们的姿势。 尽管有这种观察限制,Astra在150个神奇断裂物体上实现了91.67%的PA,而没有额外的断裂特定微调. 表5用李等人(2025年)报告的GARF和贾等人(2026年)报告的SARE的公布结果,将其绩效与专门方法进行比较。 最近专门方法报告的PA和较低的翻译误差突出显示它们在精确的片段位置上的优势。

blocks.en: 4.4 Analysis of Interactive Assembly
blocks.zh: 4.4 对互动大会的分析

blocks.en: Figure 3: GPT-6 Astra interaction trajectories across three assembly domains. Recorded states are re-rendered from the corresponding camera views. Labels show environment-call numbers (#) and elapsed time; selected MCP calls connect successive views. Insets highlight the IKEA end-frame correction. Part IDs and arguments are abbreviated; angles are in degrees.
blocks.zh: 图3:GPT-6 Astra相互作用轨迹跨越三个集合域. 所录状态从相应的相机视图中重新回复. 标签显示环境调用编号(#)和时间;选定的MCP调用连接连续视图。 Insets强调宜家最终帧校正. 部分ID和参数缩写;角度为度.

blocks.en: Interaction Dynamics. Agents actively inspect intermediate assemblies and adjust part poses using visual feedback. Figure 3 shows Astra changing viewpoint to examine the bench end frames and correcting their orientation before turning the assembly upright. In the industrial example, it temporarily lifts the perforated plate and retaining ring to inspect and adjust the blade beneath them, then restores the lifted parts. Such inspection can require moving parts away from their target poses, so intermediate geometric accuracy alone does not determine whether an action is useful.
blocks.zh: 互动动态. 特工们积极检查中间组装,并利用视觉反馈调整部分布局. 图3显示Astra改变观点,以审查长凳末端框,并在将组装向上转向之前纠正其方向。 在工业例子中,它会暂时抬起穿孔板并保留环来检查和调整其下方的叶片,然后恢复解开的部分. 这种检查可能要求将部件从目标外形上移开,因此,仅靠中间几何精度并不能确定某项行动是否有用。

blocks.en: Figure 2 summarizes how these interactions evolve across Astra and Fable trajectories. In Figure 2 (a–b), inspection queries are concentrated at the beginning, when agents acquire scene and part information. Manipulation then becomes more frequent alongside sustained visual observation. Toward the end, manipulation decreases while observation remains prominent, consistent with a shift toward checking the resulting configuration. Figure 2 (c) shows an accompanying reduction in translation and rotation magnitudes, while Figure 2 (d) shows overall increases in mean PA and SR. Manipulation magnitudes also decrease in failed evaluations, so smaller edits alone do not establish convergence to a correct assembly.
blocks.zh: 图2总结了这些相互作用如何在Astra和Fable轨迹之间演变。 在图2(a-b)中,检查询问集中在最初,即特工获得现场和部分信息时。 然后,在进行持续的视觉观察的同时,操纵也变得更加频繁。 最后,操纵减少,同时观察仍然突出,这与检查所形成的配置相一致。 图2(c)显示翻译和旋转幅度相应减少,图2(d)显示平均PA和SR总体增加。 操纵度在失败评价中也有所下降,因此仅靠较小的编辑并不能建立与正确组装的趋同.

blocks.en: Figure 4: SR gains from reference images, with paired 95% intervals: benchmark (top) and Astra on larger PartNet sets (bottom). Labels give gains in percentage points.
blocks.zh: 图4:参考图像的SR收益,间隔为95%:基准(上)和Astra在更大的PartNet集(下)上。 标签在百分点上有收益。

blocks.en: Reference images improve assembly accuracy, but their benefit varies across systems. Figure 4 compares paired evaluations with and without an image of the assembled furniture. On the benchmark’s 20 PartNet objects, Astra, Fable, and Opus gain 25, 20, and 15 SR points, respectively; the other systems show no gain or a decrease. The larger PartNet evaluations in Table 2 show a similar benefit for Astra. Across 533 tables and 148 storage objects, SR increases by 14.6 and 7.4 points, respectively. These gains extend beyond the benchmark subset and differ between furniture categories.
blocks.zh: 参考图像提高了组装准确性,但其好处因系统而异. 图4将配对评价与组装家具的图像进行比较。 在基准的20个PartNet对象上,Astra,Fable和Opus分别获得25,20和15个SR点;其他系统显示没有增减. 表2中较大规模的PartNet评价显示,Astra也有类似的好处。 在533个表格和148个存储对象中,SR分别增加了14.6和7.4点. 这些收益超出了基准子集,家具类别也不同。

blocks.en: Failure Modes. Failures span execution and geometry: Qwen and DeepSeek records contain unsupported-tool and stream-disconnection errors, while all 49 normally terminated DeepSeek runs fail geometrically. Figure 5 (a–b) shows Terra grouping 13 dispersed parts and Qwen reporting numerical alignment despite detached components. These cases reveal difficulties in assessing visible geometry from pose readback.
blocks.zh: 失败模式。 失败横跨执行和几何:Quen和DeepSeek记录包含不支持的工具和流断开错误,而所有49个通常终止的DeepSeek运行在几何上失败. 图5(a-b)显示Terra分组13个分散部分,而Quen报告数字对齐,尽管各部分相互分离。 这些案件表明,难以从姿势回溯评估可见几何。

blocks.en: Some Astra and Fable failures retain much of the target structure: translation-dominated errors account for 67.4% and 75.1% of their incorrect parts. These parts pass the correctness threshold after centroid alignment without changing orientation. Figure 5 (c) shows an Astra industrial assembly with eight of nine parts correct and one positional error; a Fable case has six of seven correct. Their reports describe unresolved seating or internal fits inferred from rendered views.
blocks.zh: 一些Astra和Fable故障保留了大部分目标结构:翻译为主的错误占其错误部分的67.4%和75.1%。 这些部分在中间行星对齐后通过正确性阈值而不改变方向. 图5(c)显示Astra工业组装,9个部分中的8个正确,1个位置错误;Fable案7个部分中的6个正确。 他们的报告描述了尚未解决的席位问题或从提出的意见中推断出来的内部问题。

blocks.en: These residual errors motivate combining visual interaction with geometric refinement, while checking whether either composition degrades correct structure. Appendix C extends the interaction and failure analyses.
blocks.zh: 这些剩余错误促使视觉相互作用与几何精细化相结合,同时检查任一成分是否降解了正确的结构. 附 录 C扩展了相互作用和失败分析.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Recorded failure cases and targets. (a) Logical grouping leaves parts dispersed. (b) Numerical pose placement leaves components detached. (c) Eight of nine parts are correct, with one residual positional error. Red marks incorrect parts; teal marks the matched target in (c). Views in (a–b) are fitted independently.

blocks.en: Robustness to Task Variations. We evaluate Astra’s sensitivity to initial layouts and part-set changes on five fixed objects per benchmark block, with paired PartNet reference conditions and one run per condition. Aggregate SR changes little across layouts, from 52.5% to 52.5% and 50.0%, but some objects switch between success and failure. blocks.en: With one part removed, retained-part PA differs substantially across domains: 88.4% on IKEA-Manual versus 43.3% on AssemblyBench. With an added distractor, Astra sometimes leaves it unincorporated and sometimes attempts to assign it a role. Because the unchanged prompt requests that all supplied parts be incorporated, these behaviors cannot be interpreted directly as anomaly-detection ability. Appendix E provides the complete paired results and trajectory audits. These small-sample, single-run findings remain exploratory.
blocks.zh: 随着一部分被删除,保留部分的巴勒斯坦权力机构在各域之间差别很大:IKEA-手册为88.4%,而Assembench为43.3%。 加上一个额外的分心器,Astra有时会让它不成立,有时会试图给它分配一个角色. 因为不变的即时请求将所有供应的部件都纳入其中,所以这些行为不能被直接解释为异常-检测能力. 附 录 E提供了完整的对结果和轨迹审计。 这些小样本、单运行的研究结果仍然是探索性的。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced AssemblyWorld, an interactive 3D assembly environment, and AssemblyWorldBench, a cross-domain benchmark evaluating general-purpose agents with a common interface and geometric criteria. Across eight systems, Astra achieves the highest overall success rate, while the stronger closed-source systems substantially outperform the evaluated open-source systems. The same pretrained agent can assemble furniture, industrial objects, and fractured objects without additional assembly-specific fine-tuning. The gap between part accuracy and complete-assembly success nevertheless shows that broad capability does not ensure geometric precision.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了AssemblyWorld,一个交互式的3D组装环境,以及AssemblyWorld Bench,一个具有共同接口和几何标准的通用代理评价的跨域基准。 通过8个系统,Astra取得了最高的总体成功率,而较强的封闭源码系统大大超过所评价的开源系统。 同样的预训剂可以组装家具,工业物品,以及断裂物体,而无需额外的组装特定微调. 然而,部分准确度与完全组装成功之间的差距表明,广泛的能力不能确保几何精确度。

blocks.en: These findings motivate a division of labor in which general-purpose models provide cross-domain reasoning, while specialized geometric methods provide precise pose estimation and refinement. The dependence on composition order in our refinement study highlights the need to design this interaction jointly. Our evaluation concerns free-space geometry and does not establish collision-free or physically stable assembly. The sampled tasks, single-run robustness tests, and two-fragment, single-seed refinement study limit the scope of our findings; unknown pretraining exposure also prevents claims of contamination-free generalization. Within these bounds, AssemblyWorld provides a common platform for investigating how general-purpose reasoning and specialized geometry can jointly improve assembly across domains.
blocks.zh: 这些结论激励了分工,即通用模型提供跨领域推理,而专用几何方法则提供精确的预测和完善。 在我们的完善研究中,对组成顺序的依赖突出了共同设计这种互动的必要性。 我们的评价涉及自由空间几何,没有建立无碰撞或身体稳定的组装。 抽样任务,单运行稳健性测试,以及双裂,单种子精细化研究,限制了我们的调查结果范围;未知的预训练接触也防止了无污染泛化的说法. 在这些范围内, AssemblyWorld提供了一个共同的平台,以调查通用推理和专用几何学如何可以共同改进跨领域的组装.

blocks.en: Each evaluation is divided into ten equal-width bins from its first to last environment call. Activity shares are computed within each active evaluation-bin and then averaged with benchmark source weights. Inspect includes object and state queries; Observe includes camera moves and captures; Manipulate includes pose edits. Grouping and episode-control calls remain in the denominator. Bins without calls are omitted and available weights renormalized. Thus, evaluations with more calls do not automatically dominate the activity curves.
blocks.zh: 每次评价从第一次到最后一次环境呼叫分为10个等宽的垃圾箱. 活动份额在每一个活跃的评价站内计算,然后以基准源加权数进行平均。 检查包括对象和状态查询; 观察包括相机动作和捕获; 操纵包括姿势编辑. 分组和插曲控制通话仍留在分母中. 没有呼叫的宾被省略,可用的权重被重新正常化. 因此,发出更多呼吁的评价不会自动支配活动曲线。

blocks.en: For each bin, manipulation magnitude is first summarized by its median within an evaluation and then by the weighted median across evaluations. Translation measures part-centroid displacement normalized by the largest-part diagonal; rotation measures angular displacement. Operations below 0.5 ∘ 0.5^{\circ} enter translation summaries, and other operations enter rotation summaries. Group edits contribute the maximum magnitude among affected parts. Missing actions are not assigned zero magnitude. Table A-10 applies the same procedure to the first and last thirds of each trajectory. Smaller late-stage motions occur in both successful and failed runs, so they do not by themselves establish successful refinement.
blocks.zh: 对于每个信箱,操纵量首先按其评价中的中位数,然后按各评价的加权中位数进行总结。 翻译衡量部分中心机器人的迁移,由最大部分对角实现正常化;旋转测量角流离失所。 0.5以下业务输入翻译摘要,其他业务输入轮换摘要. 组编辑在受影响部分中贡献最大规模. 缺失的动作未被指定为零级 。 表A-10对每一轨迹的第一和最后三分之一采用同样的程序。 在成功和失败的运行中都会出现较小的后期动议,因此它们本身并不能成功完善。

blocks.en: Execution and geometric outcomes are distinct. Astra and Fable terminate normally in all 100 benchmark tasks. Qwen has 65 timeouts and 14 execution failures; DeepSeek has 17 and 34, respectively. All 49 normally terminated DeepSeek runs fail geometrically. These observations establish failures of the evaluated model–harness combinations, without attributing every error to the model’s geometric reasoning.

blocks.zh: 图3转而采用为可见中间操纵所选的个案. 它的离线渲染保存了被记录的部分姿势和带有中心框架的摄像头方向;它们不是代理人观察到的原始图像. 参考图像与所提供的原始材料相对应。

blocks.en: In the IKEA bench example, the agent places the seat and both end frames before adding the stretcher, whereas the manual introduces the stretcher with the first end frame. In the industrial example, provisional placements are revised before and after inspecting the covered blade. These trajectories show correspondence to instructional relationships without reproducing every illustrated step. A different placement order alone does not establish failure to use a manual. These qualitative examples illustrate assembly behavior rather than estimate failure frequencies or instruction-following rates.
blocks.zh: 在宜家长凳的例子中,代理在添加担架之前先放置座位和两个端框,而手动则引入第一端框的担架. 在工业例子中,在检查被覆盖的叶片之前和之后对临时放置进行修改。 这些轨迹显示了与教学关系之间的对应关系,而没有复制每一个显示步骤. 单凭不同的安置令并不能证明没有使用手册。 这些定性例子说明了组装行为,而不是估计故障频率或指令跟随率.

blocks.en: Appendix D Combining Agents with Geometric Models
blocks.zh: 附录D 将物剂与几何模型相结合

blocks.en: All four configurations use the same 150 two-fragment Fantastic Breaks objects, fixed point samples, part identities, normalization, and anchor-aligned evaluator. Each object has 5,000 area-weighted surface samples with at least 20 per part. Sampling and inference use fixed random seeds. The largest sampled part is the anchor. Standard GARF is rerun on these inputs; its matched result in Table 6 is distinct from the published GARF result in Table 5 .
blocks.zh: 所有四种配置都使用相同的150个双裂Freast Breaks对象,固定点样本,部分身份,正常化,以及锚对齐评价. 每个物体都有5000个面积加权的表面样本,每个部分至少有20个. 采样和推论使用固定随机种子. 最大的样本部分是锚. 在这些投入上重新运行了标准全球财务报告格式;表6中的对应结果与表5中公布的全球财务报告格式结果不同。

blocks.en: Both GARF configurations use the released GARF-mini checkpoint without training or tuning. Standard inference uses random initialization and a one-step initialization stage, followed by 20 refinement steps. Agent-initialized inference replaces the initialization stage with the agent poses and retains the same refinement schedule. One rigid transformation aligns the agent anchor to its target while preserving relative part poses; the anchor remains fixed during inference. No non-anchor target pose is supplied.
blocks.zh: 两种GARF配置都使用释放的GARF-mini检查站,不经过训练或调音. 标准推论采用随机初始化和单步初始化阶段,然后20个完善步骤. 代理初始推论用代理形式取代初始化阶段,并保留同样的完善时间表. 一种刚性转换使物剂锚与目标一致,同时保持相对部分的姿势;锚在推论中保持不变。 不提供非锁定目标姿势。

blocks.en: For GARF-to-Agent, the predicted poses initialize the original meshes with no preceding interaction history. Astra receives the original no-reference prompt and uses medium effort through Codex, without target geometry or the GARF trajectory. These runs follow the original source-level fracture setting without a wall-time cutoff. All 150 terminate normally.
blocks.zh: 对于GARF对代理公司来说,预测形成初始化的原始介质,没有之前的相互作用历史. Astra接收了最初的无参考即时,并通过Codex使用中等努力,没有目标几何或GARF轨迹. 这些运行遵循原始的源层断裂设置,没有墙时断裂. 所有150个正常终止。

blocks.en: Relative to standard GARF, agent initialization improves PA on ten objects and leaves it unchanged on 140. Relative to the unrefined agent, Agent-to-GARF improves PA on 15 objects, degrades it on 29, and leaves it unchanged on 106. Relative to standard GARF, GARF-to-Agent improves PA on 33 objects, degrades it on five, and leaves it unchanged on 112; shape CD improves on 125, worsens on 23, and is unchanged on two, using tolerance 10 − 8 10^{-8} . Figure A-5 shows both improvements and regressions. These single-run, two-fragment results do not establish seed-averaged superiority or transfer to multi-part industrial assemblies.
blocks.zh: 相对于标准的GARF,代理初始化在十个对象上改进了PA,在140个对象上保持不变. 相对于未加工剂,Agent-to-GARF在15个物体上改进PA,在29个物体上降解,在106个物体上保持不变. 相对于标准的GARF,GARF-对Agent改进了33个物体的PA,5个物体的PA,112个物体的PA,1个物体的PA,1个物体的PA,1个物体的PA,1个物体的PA,1个物体的PA,1个物体的PA,1个物体的PA,1个物体的PA,1个物体的PA,1个物体的PA,1个物体的PA,1个物体的PA,2个物体的PA,2个物体的PA,1个物体的PA,1个物体的PA,1个物体的PA,1个物体,1个物体的PA,1个物体的PA,1个物体,1个物体的PA,1个物体的GRF,1个物体的GRF,1个物体,1个物体的PA,1个物体的PA,5个物体的PA,1个物体的PA,1个物体的PA,1个物体的PA,1个物体的PA 图A-5显示既有改进也有倒退。 这些单跑,双裂的结果不能确定种子平均优越性或转移到多部分工业大会.

blocks.en: Figure A-5: Per-object changes in shape CD for the two composition orders. Each point is one of the same 150 objects; points below the diagonal improve. Both axes are logarithmic.
blocks.zh: 图A-5:两种组成顺序的每个对象的形状CD变化. 每个点都是同一个150个物体之一;对角改进后的点下面. 两轴对数.

blocks.en: Appendix E Robustness Experiments
blocks.zh: 附录E 强健性实验

blocks.en: Five fixed samples per benchmark block are selected using part-count strata, without selection on performance. PartNet uses two chairs, two tables, and one storage object, paired across reference conditions. The study contains 20 distinct objects and 25 baseline conditions. Each object receives two alternative layouts, one randomly removed part except on Fantastic Breaks, and one added part from a different object in the same source. PartNet conditions share the perturbations. Geometry, references, targets, and normalization remain fixed; inventory changes preserve unaffected parts’ initial poses.
blocks.zh: 每个基准区块选择5个固定样本,采用部分计数等级,不选择业绩。 PartNet使用两张椅子,两张表格,和一个存储对象,对齐跨越参考条件. 该研究包含20个不同的对象和25个基线条件. 每个对象都得到两个不同的布局,一个是除"神奇断层"(Fantific Breaks)外随机移除的部分,另一个是从同一个源头的不同对象中添加的部分. PartNet的条件与扰动相同。 几何、参考、目标和正常化仍然是固定不变的;库存变化保留了未受影响的部件的初始构成。

blocks.en: Selection, inventory changes, and alternative layouts use fixed random seeds. Each of the 95 new conditions is run once with medium-effort Astra, the original prompt, and a one-hour limit. All runs terminate normally. The unchanged prompt requests incorporation of all supplied parts and does not identify the perturbation. The 25 baselines are rescored using the same evaluator as the variants.
blocks.zh: 选择,目录变更,以及替代布局使用固定随机种子. 95个新条件中每个都运行一次中功Astra,原速,限时1小时. 所有运行正常终止。 未变的即时请求包括所有供应的部件,没有说明扰动。 25个基线使用与变体相同的评价器重新计分。

blocks.en: Layout variants use benchmark PA and SR. Distractor evaluation excludes the added part from registration, correspondence, and scoring. Missing-part evaluation scores retained parts against their targets at the original scale. Retained-part completeness is not complete-object success, and retained-part PA has a different denominator from full-object PA. Figure A-6 summarizes the results; Table A-12 preserves the object-level pairing.
blocks.zh: 版式变体使用基准PA和SR. 灾害评估将新增部分排除在登记、信函和评分之外。 缺失部分评价分数保留了部分与原标的对比。 保留部分完整性不是完全对象成功,保留部分巴勒斯坦权力机构与完全对象巴勒斯坦权力机构有不同的分母。 图A-6总结了结果;表A-12保留了对象级的配对.

blocks.en: Figure A-6: GPT-6 Astra under task variations on five fixed samples per benchmark block, with one run per condition. PartNet reference conditions share objects and perturbations. Missing-part evaluation measures only retained parts; Fantastic Breaks is excluded from this condition.
blocks.zh: 图A-6:每个基准区块5个固定样本任务变化下的GPT-6 Astra,每个条件运行一次。 PartNet的参考条件共享对象和扰动. 缺失部分评价措施只保留部分; " 惊人断层 " 被排除在这一条件之外。

blocks.en: Table A-12: Paired task-variation results. Each cell reports PA (%) / SR (0 or 1); the missing-part column instead reports retained-part PA / retained-part completeness. A dash indicates an untested condition. Each condition is run once.
blocks.zh: 表A-12:任务变化结果。 每个单元格报告PA (%) / SR(0或1);缺失部分栏报告保留部分PA / 保留部分完整性。 一个破折号表示一个未经测试的状况. 每一个条件都运行一次.

blocks.en: We examine actions, final geometry, and reports for all 20 missing-part and 25 distractor runs. Four IKEA and three AssemblyBench missing-part reports identify an absent component. A completion declaration can coexist with a reported omission. Under distractors, four IKEA and three AssemblyBench reports identify an uninstalled part, although several such parts were never moved. On Fantastic Breaks, two runs attempt to incorporate all three fragments, two try the extra fragment and then move it aside, and one reports leaving it unincorporated. These trajectories distinguish reported recognition, attempted use, and non-incorporation.
blocks.zh: 我们检查行动,最后几何, 和报告所有20个缺失部分和25个分散干扰器运行。 4份宜家协会和3份大会奔驰缺失部分报告确定了一个缺失部分。 完成申报可以与所报告的遗漏同时存在。 在分心器下,4份宜家和3份Assembly Bench报告确定了一个未安装的部分,尽管若干这样的部分从未移动过. 在"神奇的破碎"上,两个跑步试图将所有三个碎片都融入其中,两个跑步尝试额外的碎片,然后将其移到一边,一个报告没有将其并入其中. 这些轨迹区分了所报告的承认、企图使用和不并入。

blocks.en: The unchanged all-parts instruction influences distractor handling. Without a reference, the intended inventory may also be underdetermined. The small paired sample and single run per condition support exploratory observations, not repeated-run reliability or robustness to larger numbers of missing or extra parts.
blocks.zh: 不变的全段指令会影响分心器的处理. 如无参考文献,预期的存货也可能被低估。 每个条件的小型配对样本和单次运行支持探索性观测,而不是重复运行的可靠性或稳健性到更多的缺失或额外部件.
